headline: One picture, 146 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 5 different files and attached to 146 different works in 4 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 146 separate works.

The 5 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 6 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.014 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): ea51b42a6e3f on 72 works, 0355786f91a6 on 32 works, 36923334f6d0 on 30 works, 9322afb60d2b on 8 works, 50f1ea154794 on 4 works.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (146).
These works are spread over 4 blocks: Dakore, Kadaura, Kuthaund, Maheva.
